svg.title: One incentive system for all participants.
svg.desc: AVM protocol fees fund separate reserve-asset reward pots. Bidders commit credits, receive proportional asset rewards, and remaining credit bids burn at finalization. A declining scheduled global credit budget is divided by AVA weights and allocated through eligible holdings and referral ancestry. Collected credits may be spent in clearing or pledged to direct future AVA allocations. Pledged credits must be released before bidding.

g.text: Participation earns credits. Activity funds rewards.
WHERE THE REWARD ASSETS COME FROM
Release pledged credits before using them to bid.
Separate pots for each reserve asset
Growth shares the emission budget. Useful activity can grow the reward pots.
Intended composition · One global schedule per protocol instance · Core incentive paths
